title: Success Rate of Professional Conversion Programme
what_it_is: Success Rate of Professional Conversion Programme

sections.label: Healthcare Conversion Programmes outcomes
sections.summary: The Government funds PCPs for healthcare conversions, admitting over 400 Singaporeans since 2009, with high completion and retention rates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Today, we have PCPs for conversion to registered and enrolled nurses, physiotherapists and occupational therapists, diagnostic radiographers and dental surgery assistants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The Government provides significant funding for the course fees and allowances during the period of training.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We have admitted more than 400 Singaporeans from non-healthcare sectors into the Healthcare Conversion Programmes since 2009.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: For the 223 enrolled between 2009 and 2011, 82% completed their training and were successfully placed into a healthcare job.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Among those successfully placed, 92% remained in their jobs after the end of the minimum service period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: For example, over the last three years, 54 training scholarships and sponsorships were provided for non-clinical in-service staff to convert into clinical roles as nurses and allied health professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: More than 750 enrolled nurses entered our Polytechnic nursing programmes over the last three years to undergo skills training to become registered nurses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: The bulk of the PCP is standardised because they are based on the nursing modules or the specific Allied Health Professional modules.
